notes.title: Patch and New TomoToro games!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a long time since the release of the «Lighthouse of Guiding Flames», but we haven't been sitting still and have prepared a patch with major improvements! We plan to release another patch soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35439845/18fab37b4dc12caa54e7a18f74f1c802e9b2ebbf.jpg

We are also preparing two more novels for release.
This time you'll be treated to plenty of secrets and creepy scenes as we delve deeper into the mystery and thriller genres.

If any of the novels interests you, make sure to add it to your wishlist!

Graces: Posthumous Wish

A novel about a girl named Aki who has a curse of bad luck on her. The game will have lots of ghosts and creepy bad endings, so you'll be able to enjoy the atmosphere of school scary stories and creepypaste.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35439845/5538b34a462af2fb8e8b0768a3ea29704c4b27a4.jpg


Amnea28: Two Eternities

A story about students who went to a hotel in the middle of the forest to attend psychology lectures. We are sure the characters and their dramatic past will not leave you indifferent. The hotel «Amnea» is a very dangerous place!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35439845/d96e62f7d4682b9e0d86689d87df0e342f0a63b2.jpg

notes.title: LIGHTHOUSE OF GUIDING FLAMES' UPDATE FOR WINDOWS!
notes.notes:
The first of two planned patches is out! The novel deserves some cosmetic changes, and now we're ready to publish some of them.

Updates:

- new design of the dialogue window and bigger font size for comfortable reading (if you see light textbox after the update, switch it to dark in the game settings)
- new art and main menu design
- new functions in settings: skip all text, turn off all sounds, mousewheel action
- fixed the Scenes crash bug
- fixed typos, added slight corrections of text
- achievements secion

Technical details:

- the game perceives text as completely new; to skip it, turn on "skip all text" option in settings
- the novel now works only on 64-bit version of Windows
- Linus and Mac versions aren't updated, because we can't test them

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Hi friends! 
Finally we did it with TomoToro team, the Lighthouse of guiding flames is live on steam.

It was a long way from a small gamejam project at Anivisual Contest to this complete game. Thank you for your support, it was because of you that we decided to bring it to the end.

Here are the changes from the old version:
— Opening
— Original OST
— Achievements
— Translation
— Miscellaneous, copyright issues (new bonus, fonts etc.)

THANK YOU
